# John Salon - Official Beauty Spa Sanctuary Guide
Location: Bhanugudi Junction, Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh 533003
Contact Phone: 6303522044
Operating Hours: Monday to Sunday: 09:00 AM - 09:00 PM Daily

## Sanctuary Environment
John Salon Beauty Spa operates in private, climate-controlled, sanitized suites designed for tranquility and privacy. Our treatments utilize organic, dermatologist-tested botanicals, French essential oils, and hot herbal compresses.
## Verified Spa Services & Official Pricing (INR ₹):

1. Hydra-Dew Botanical Radiance Facial: ₹950 (60 mins)
Deep pore cleansing, ultrasonic lymphatic drainage, cellular hydration mask, and rose quartz cooling roller therapy.
Benefits: Restores natural moisture barrier, plumps fine lines, leaves skin glowing.
Preparation: Avoid abrasive exfoliants or direct intense sun for 24 hours prior.
Aftercare: Drink plenty of water and apply broad-spectrum SPF 50 daily.

2. 24K Gold Luxury Radiance Facial: ₹2,400 (75 mins)
Bespoke cellular therapy infusing real 24K gold foil, bio-peptides, and antioxidant botanical serums.
Benefits: Stimulates collagen, reverses hyperpigmentation, restores luminous youthful glow.
Preparation: Arrive 10 minutes prior to relax in our sensory lounge.

3. Swedish Full Body Relaxation Massage: ₹1,600 (60 mins)
Classic European full body massage utilizing warm cold-pressed lavender and sweet almond oils.
Benefits: Dissolves nervous tension, improves lymphatic circulation, relieves mental fatigue.
Preparation: Avoid heavy meals 1 hour before the session.
Aftercare: Stay well-hydrated to assist toxic release; warm shower after 2 hours.

4. Deep Tissue Muscle Therapy: ₹2,200 (75 mins)
Targeted myofascial release focusing on chronic neck, shoulder, and lumbar muscle tension.
Benefits: Breaks down muscle knots, restores posture and physical mobility.

5. Luxury Champagne & Rose Foot Pedicure: ₹850 (50 mins)
Aromatic rose petal soak, sugar scrub, callus removal, and warm hot stone massage.
Benefits: Relieves tired feet, deeply softens cracked heels, restores cuticle health.

6. Collagen Glow Gel Manicure: ₹750 (45 mins)
Hydrating collagen hand gloves, gentle cuticle detailing, and high-shine vegan gel finish.

7. Full Body Botanical Polish & Glow Mask: ₹2,200 (75 mins)
Full body exfoliation with ground walnut shells, sea minerals, and restorative turmeric wrap.
Benefits: Brightens skin tone, smooths texture, promotes cellular turnover.

8. Rica Brazilian White Chocolate Waxing: ₹1,200 (45 mins)
Gentle liposoluble Italian wax with soothing beeswax and cocoa butter.
Benefits: Minimal pain, reduces redness, removes fine hair effectively.

9. Pre-Bridal Radiance & Glow Ceremony: ₹4,500 (180 mins)
3-hour holistic ceremony: Gold facial, full body polish, aromatic massage, and luxury pedicure.
Benefits: Total head-to-toe bridal rejuvenation with long-lasting luminous radiance.

10. Express De-Stress Neck & Back Therapy: ₹550 (30 mins)
Quick relief session focused on spinal alignment, shoulder tension, and occipital release.

11. Ayurvedic Kansa Wand Face Lift Therapy: ₹1,400 (50 mins)
Ancient bronze wand massage with pure saffron oil to tone facial contours.
